note: Example Hinge prompt answers and comments that work: specific, playful, easy to answer.
pairs: My simple pleasures: a good coffee and the Sunday crossword
ok but do you do it in pen or are you a pencil coward
My simple pleasures: long walks with my dog
important question: does the dog approve of your dates or do I need to bring treats
I'm looking for: someone who can make me laugh
a horse walks into a bar. that's it, that's my audition. how'd I do
Typical Sunday: farmers market then a nap
farmers market then a nap is elite. what's your must-buy, I'm guessing peaches
I go crazy for: tacos
corn or flour tortilla. choose carefully, this decides everything
Two truths and a lie: I've been skydiving, I can juggle, I've never seen Star Wars
the lie is skydiving. nobody who skydives forgets to mention it in every prompt
The way to win me over is: cook me dinner
I make a pasta that's gotten two people engaged. not to me, but still
I'm weirdly attracted to: people who know a lot about bugs
I know exactly one bug fact and I've been saving it for this moment
My most irrational fear: geese
geese are not irrational. geese have chosen violence. you're just observant
Together we could: find the best pizza in the city
I accept this mission. what's your current number one so I know who to beat
A shower thought I recently had: is a hot dog a sandwich
it's a taco. I'll defend this over drinks if you're brave enough
I'll fall for you if: you send me memes at 2am
risky, my 2am memes are unhinged. is there a quality bar or just volume
My greatest strength: I give amazing gifts
big claim. what's the best gift you've ever given, I need evidence
Dating me is like: a road trip with good snacks
what's the snack lineup, because this is a dealbreaker conversation
I want someone who: will hike with me
I hike. mostly to the view and then complain on the way down. still in?
Green flags I look for: someone who's nice to waiters
I tip like it's a love language. what's a red flag that ends it for you instantly
Unusual skills: I can name any song in 3 seconds
challenge accepted. loser buys the first round
My love language: quality time
perfect, I'm free most evenings and very good at showing up with snacks
I bet you can't: beat me at Mario Kart
rainbow road, best of three, loser plans the next date
The key to my heart is: really good bread
sourdough or are you a croissant person. this matters
Photo: hiking at the top of a mountain
that view is unreal. did you make it up there or is this a really good green screen
Photo: holding a huge fish
ok the fish is impressive but I need to know its name
Photo: dog in a sweater
who's the model and are they single
My most controversial opinion: pineapple belongs on pizza
I respect a person who'll die on a hill. even a sticky one
Let's debate this topic: cats vs dogs
dogs, but I'd let a cat win the argument because they'd be smug about it anyway
Biggest risk I've taken: moved across the country alone
that's brave. what's the thing you miss most from back home
Ideal first date: cocktails at a speakeasy
I know a place with a password. you'll have to earn it though
A life goal of mine: visit every national park
how many are you at? I need to know if I'm talking to an amateur or a legend
The hallmark of a good relationship: inside jokes
we should start one immediately. any ideas or should I go first
My go-to karaoke song: Mr. Brightside
a classic. do you peak at the first chorus or save it for the end
I'm convinced that: breakfast for dinner is the best dinner
pancakes at 8pm is the move. syrup or are you a butter purist
Don't hate me if I: talk to strangers' dogs before the strangers
honestly the correct order of operations
We'll get along if: you like trivia nights
my team name ideas are unbeatable. our trivia skills, less so
Best travel story: got lost in Tokyo for a whole day
best way to see a city honestly. what's the best thing you found while lost
I recently discovered that: I love pottery
are your bowls actually bowls yet or still abstract art
This year, I really want to: run a half marathon
that's awesome. how's training going, are we in the hating it or loving it phase
Worst idea I've ever had: bangs
everyone gets one bangs era. it builds character
My happy place: the beach at sunset
sunset swim or sunset with a drink in the sand
You should not go out with me if: you hate spontaneous plans
I once got a burrito in another state on a whim. we'll be fine
I'm overly competitive about: board games
Catan or Monopoly. one of these answers ends friendships
